entries.title: Mission (fictional)
entries.body: Bluebird Family Fund is a made-up nonprofit used for testing. It pays licensed therapists so families can start counseling quickly.

entries.title: Completion (fictional)
entries.body: In this invented example year, 7 in 10 families who started therapy completed at least 8 sessions.

entries.title: Closing paragraph (fictional draft)
entries.body: Draft only: we would welcome the chance to discuss how this fictional program could grow with your support.
